logline: When a frantic mother brings her critically ill child to the woodland cottage, Juliana successfully cures him with her mother's herbal remedies, unknowingly igniting dangerous rumors that reach the ears of the Blond Nobleman.

moments.description: Heavy pounding shatters the calm inside the cottage as Alexander prepares to answer the door.
A soaked, distraught peasant mother begs Juliana to save her feverish child.
moments.key_dialogue: Please! They told me there was a woman here who knows herbs. My boy is burning with fever!

moments.description: The mother breaks down in relief as her son's fever finally breaks.
The grateful mother promises to spread word of Juliana's healing throughout the village against Alexander's warnings.
moments.key_dialogue: I will tell the village what you did. They will never forget you.

moments.description: The former groom informs the Blond Nobleman that a war veteran resembles the late Duke and bears the exact same war scar.
moments.key_dialogue: The man is said to have the same kind of scar the Duke carried after the war.

moments.description: The Blond Nobleman stares into the fire in mounting terror as creeping paranoia paralyzes him before the screen cuts to black.
